entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling because I'd like to return a helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details. Okay, I see the delivery was 65 days ago. Let me just check our policy... Yes, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. Since I am going through the hassle of a return, is there any possibility of getting a 10% discount code for a future order? I'm already looking at another helmet and want to make sure I get the right one this time, especially regarding its safety features.

I'm glad you're prioritizing safety, that's the most important feature of any helmet. While I can't add a discount code for a return based on color preference, I can assure you that you will receive a full refund once we receive the item. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. The full refund is what's most important. I appreciate your help processing this so quickly.
You're very welcome. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
